items.title: Rank is unchanged by extending the ground domain
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for an extension of domains R inside R' the rank of an R-module M equals the rank of M tensor R' over R' (statement lines 5071-5075), and the author's proof identifies the reason in one sentence: dimension of a vector space is invariant under extension of the ground field (proof lines 5078-5080). What has to be seen is that the two ranks are two dimensions of two vector spaces over two different fields, K and the fraction field of R', and that the vector space for R' is the base change of the one for R along K to K', which is where the invariance applies. There is no computation left at the end of the proof; the content is the identification of the two dimensions.
